climate_sources.fact_used: IMD reporting groups March-May as pre-monsoon, June-September as southwest monsoon, and October-December as post-monsoon.
The northeast monsoon affects the southern peninsular region during October-December, so post-monsoon content should not assume all-India dry weather.
